content.text:
I've fixed the likely cause of the panic, but nothing has been built or run, and I never reproduced the crash.

The cause is in `inner_string_text` in `crates/biome_html_syntax/src/lib.rs`. It assumed every string-literal token has a quote at each end and sliced from 1 to `len - 1`. The HTML lexer also emits string-literal tokens for unquoted attribute values, such as `<script src=a></script>`. A one-character unquoted value gives the range 1..0, which trips the `start.raw <= end.raw` assertion. I can't confirm your `bundle.html` contains such an attribute, since I haven't seen the file.

- **`inner_string_text`:** it now strips the delimiters only when the token is at least two characters long and starts with a quote. Unquoted values come back unchanged.
- **`build_vue_directive_candidate`:** in `crates/biome_service/src/file_handlers/html/parse_embedded_nodes.rs`, the content offset assumed a leading quote. It now adds 1 only when the value is actually quoted.

I didn't add a regression test. Please run the existing HTML tests and `biome check` on a file with a short unquoted attribute value, or on your `bundle.html`.
